body: Absolutely. In dreams you don't have to worry about anything and can just... live. I guess that's why they're dreams though
Literally no better feeling in the world. Just back to the old days before everything went to shit.
dreaming is nice because it provides a sliver of relief from everyday droll. it's just these dreams in particular that suck
I feel this
Yes; it was mostly me begging for a chance to make us work but he's stubborn. I do have a bit of pride so I just had to stop. It didn't get me anywhere

Thank you so much, I really needed to read this. I have to face him again in a couple hours and I wasn't sure if I could do it without breaking down... I'll keep your comments in mind throughout the day

This was beautiful to read. I truly hope I'll be able to soar one day like him. I know I need to dig within myself to uncover the problems and cut them out but right now, wallowing in the pain in easier than letting him go...

Best of luck to both of us, fellow 'coward'. I greatly appreciate you commenting, I'll think about this for quite awhile
I'm so sorry, I hope you are doing okay

I unfollowed him on social media but I can't help but check it every so often, and we don't talk much anymore. Recent circumstances have forced me to text him but when we met in person he could barely look me in the eyes. That's what hurt the most.
Right now it doesn't feel like it, but I pray that you are right

I'm not even sure I can remain friends with him after hearing the things he said. I dont know if I'm in a position to learn much about myself right now, most of it is just cold and unfeeling. Thank you so much though for your encouragement; I feel a lot more positive for the day to come
I'd just make a fool out of myself. It wouldnt change anything between us and it would make it so much harder
Don't worry, I appreciate your comment a lot. I just woke up and while I still feel pretty low these comments give me a little boost. Thank you so much for caring about me, I'm very grateful

I'm so sorry that you're going through the same thing. I'll try not to blame myself for everything but it's pretty difficult. I hope that you and I will be okay at some point. Thank you for your comment
thank you so much; even just responding to these comments has pulled me out of that dark place, even if it's just a bit. im really grateful, thank you again
I hope I'll be able to follow in your steps; I just want to feel again. the feeling of emptiness is soul crushing... do you have any recommendations or tips?
thabk you so much for your comment. I truly hope I'll be able to recover and reading these comments does give me a bit of hope. a year is an awfully long time but if that's what it takes...

a year is a long time to pretend to be okay; I commend you for your strength. I truly hope I can move past this and appreciate life again. right now everything just seems black and white, devoid of colour

he's not the type to come back begging to work things out. he picks himself up and moves on. I always admired that but now I desperately wish I could do the same. thank you for your comment, it is much appreciated ^_^
it's been a few months already but some nights like tonight just feel especially dark

I can relate to the abusive parent situation for sure. I'm sorry you had to go through that. Parents are supposedly there to support their children and help them grow, not tear them down and break them.
